description: Update 0002 (28 March 2026): The solicitation date is tentatively schedule for the week of 13 April 2026. A draft of the Phase Two solicitation requirements, evaluation criteria and Seed Project will be included to provide interested offerors a representative sample of task orders to be solicited under this contract. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming and 2) Industry Day - Ground Based Strategic Deterrent Utility Corridor, Francis E. Warren Air Force Base, Wyoming for reference.
